summary: High-end watch accessories — boxes, papers, certificates, bracelets, winders. Empty Rolex/Omega/Patek boxes alone trade $100-2000+; vintage papers with matching serial numbers add 30-50% to a watch sale. Auction listings often DON'T mention the brand explicitly — they say 'Submariner box', 'Speedmaster papers', 'Daytona bracelet', etc. We catch BOTH explicit-brand AND implicit-model listings via Pass 2c in the matcher (similar to Loungefly's Pass 2b for character backpacks). Sweet spot: $20-200 buy → $100-1500 resale on vintage Rolex/Omega/Patek/AP accessories.
field_workflow: Boxes: photograph maker stamping inside lid + outer leather/wood grain detail
Boxes: serial number on inner card MUST match accompanying watch (if sold together)
Papers: ink should be ORIGINAL pen, not photocopied — hold to light to verify watermark
Bracelets: end-link reference number stamped on the spring-bar end (e.g., 580 / 593 for Rolex Oyster)
Bracelets: clasp stamping identifies generation + production year
Hangtags: original price tag on string + factory anti-tamper seal still attached = premium
Winders: brand-OEM (Rolex / Patek) >> third-party (Wolf, Heiden) by 5-10x
Counterfeit RISK: boxes are extensively faked — verify font kerning, leather grain, magnetic-clasp pull strength against authenticated examples
skip_list: Generic wooden watch box (storage display, not OEM)

brands.notes: IMPORTANT: Rolex accessories alone trade for serious money — don't dismiss an empty Rolex box. Vintage 'coffin' boxes (1960s-70s wooden) are the apex at $400-2000. Modern green-leatherette boxes still pull $100-350 on their own. Bracelets with correct end-link references for the watch model are the highest-margin accessory ($300-1500). Auction listings frequently say 'Submariner box' / 'Daytona papers' WITHOUT 'Rolex' — Pass 2c in the matcher catches these. Counterfeit risk is HIGH on boxes specifically; verify kerning + leather grain + magnetic clasp pull against authenticated examples. Disqualifiers reject 'Tudor England' history books and 'BB58' women's clothing SKUs — both share the 'tudor' alias coincidentally.

brands.notes: Omega accessories second only to Rolex in collector demand. Speedmaster 'Moonwatch' bracelets (1450/1039 references) are the most-faked accessory in the watch world — verify rivet construction and end-link stamping. Vintage wood-grain Omega boxes (pre-1990) hold premium. Master Chronometer certificate card (post-2015 only) adds 10-15% to a sale. Disqualifiers reject Zebco Omega Pro fishing reels (different domain — handled by fishing_reels_bolo.json).

brands.notes: Patek Philippe accessories are the apex of watch collecting — even an empty Nautilus box has cleared $1500+ at auction. The Patek Philippe Seal (post-2009) replaced the Geneva Seal as the certification mark on paperwork. Counterfeit risk is EXTREME at this tier; only buy from known-authentic sources or with provenance.

brands.notes: Royal Oak integrated bracelets command extreme premium because they're impossible to retrofit cleanly to anything but the matching reference. Counterfeit risk EXTREME — only buy with verified provenance. Disqualifiers reject Roland AP-7 Jet Phaser guitar pedals — same 'AP-7' code, completely different domain.

brands.notes: Second-tier Swiss luxury (Vacheron, Breitling, IWC, Panerai, JLC, TAG, Zenith, Grand Seiko, Hublot, Bell & Ross). Vacheron Constantin rivals Patek in accessory pricing. Vintage Heuer (pre-1985 TAG merger) is its own collector category — premium over modern TAG Heuer. Grand Seiko is the Japanese luxury entry; rising market 2024-26.

platform_notes.eBay: Dominant marketplace for watch accessories. Filter sold-listings hard — asking prices are commonly 2-3x what items actually clear at.
platform_notes.Chrono24: Primary buyer-side comp benchmark for full watch sales. Use to verify what an accessory ADDS to a paired watch sale ($X with box/papers vs $Y without).
platform_notes.WatchUSeek / r/Watches: Community sanity-check for serial-number authenticity questions. Don't sell here — use as the verification step before listing on eBay.
platform_notes.Bob's Watches / Crown & Caliber: Pre-owned dealers — they don't pay accessory premiums (they buy the watch + take the box for free). Resale path only if you have the matching watch.
